title: Dear Lord, We Come at Set of Sun

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Dear Lord, we come at set of sun,
And at Your feet we kneel
This day, Your sign and seal.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Our earthly tasks we lay aside,
To enter now Your holy rest,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Sweet Sabbath rest, your sacred hours
That reaches back to Eden's gate

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: And when this earth shall be renewed,
Shall all redeemed each Sabbath day
Still meet to praise their God.
